; Every grammar rule of spec 5.2, written for the transpiler's tests.
; Nothing here comes from a game file.
scn TSGrammarScript

short counter
int asInt
long asLong
float rate
ref target
reference other

begin GameMode
	set counter to counter + 1
	set rate to ( rate * 2 - 1 ) / 4
	set asInt to -counter
	set asLong to !asInt
	if counter >= 10 && rate < 0.5 || asInt == 3
		set counter to 0
	elseif counter != 5
		set target to player
	else
		return
	endif
	if ( GetStage TSQuest >= 20 )
		SetStage TSQuest 30
	endif
	TSDoorRef.Lock 50
	player.AddItem TSKey, 1
	set counter to player.GetItemCount TSKey + 2
	set rate to TSQuest.qRate
	set TSQuest.qCount to 7
	set asInt to TSMayorRef.mood
end

begin OnActivate
	if IsActionRef player == 1
		Activate
	endif
end

begin OnTriggerEnter player
	ShowMessage TSMessage counter
end

begin OnDeath
	RewardXP 10
end
